summary: Restore from the install directory with `./setup.sh -e 'restore_backup_file=/path/to/nondefault/backup.tar.gz' -r`, or just `./setup.sh -r` when the TAR is in the default location.
questions: What command restores AAP from backup?
How do I restore from a backup in another directory?

answer_card.title: Restore with setup.sh (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd <installation directory>
./setup.sh -r    # backup next to setup.sh
./setup.sh -e 'restore_backup_file=/path/to/nondefault/backup.tar.gz' -r
```
